verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents an official CLI that renders and tests Composition Functions without a cluster, troubleshoots Compositions, Composite Resources and Managed Resources, and builds, installs, updates and pushes packages. That clearly covers the core of having an official CLI. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive automation modes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
